actor_awards.notes: Won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for her debut film role in 'All the King's Men' (1949). Orson Welles called her 'the world's greatest living radio actress'. She famously provided the demonic voice of Pazuzu in 'The Exorcist' (1973).

filmography.title: All the King's Men
filmography.role_description: The cynical, hard-bitten political secretary and mistress to Willie Stark, who ultimately seeks revenge when he betrays her. McCambridge's film debut.
filmography.plot: The rise and fall of a corrupt politician, who starts as a man of the people but loses his soul to power.
filmography.awards: Oscar: Win – Best Supporting Actress; Golden Globe: Win – Best Supporting Actress, New Star of the Year

filmography.title: Giant
filmography.role_description: The tough, domineering sister of Bick Benedict who runs the Reata ranch and resents his new wife.
filmography.plot: Sprawling epic covering the life of a Texas cattle rancher and his family and associates.

filmography.title: The Exorcist
filmography.role_description: The terrifying, guttural voice of the demon possessing Regan MacNeil. McCambridge went to extreme lengths (swallowing raw eggs, chain-smoking, drinking) to achieve the voice.
filmography.plot: When a 12-year-old girl is possessed by a mysterious entity, her mother seeks the help of two priests to save her.

filmography.title: Johnny Guitar
filmography.role_description: A sexually repressed, vengeful townswoman who leads a lynch mob against saloon owner Vienna out of jealousy.
filmography.plot: A strong-willed saloon owner is targeted by a lynch mob led by a rival woman, forcing her to rely on a former lover, a gunfighter named Johnny Guitar.

filmography.title: Touch of Evil
filmography.role_description: A brief but memorable, uncredited cameo as a leather-jacketed female gang leader in a motel.
filmography.plot: A stark, perverse story of murder, kidnapping, and police corruption in a Mexican border town.

filmography.title: Suddenly, Last Summer
filmography.role_description: The mother of the young woman (Elizabeth Taylor) who is being pressured into a lobotomy.
filmography.plot: A wealthy matriarch attempts to force a neurosurgeon to perform a lobotomy on her niece to hide the truth about her son's death.
filmography.awards: Oscar: Nomination – Best Actress (Katharine Hepburn, Elizabeth Taylor)

filmography.title: Lightning Strikes Twice
filmography.role_description: A woman whose jealousy and unrequited love drive the plot in this murder mystery.
filmography.plot: An actress on vacation meets and falls for a man who is the prime suspect in his wife's murder.

filmography.title: Cimarron
filmography.role_description: A settler who endures the hardships of the Oklahoma land rush and the changing times.
filmography.plot: A newspaper editor settles in an Oklahoma boom town with his reluctant wife at the end of the nineteenth century.

filmography.title: A Farewell to Arms
filmography.role_description: The strict head nurse who oversees the hospital where Catherine Barkley works.
filmography.plot: An American ambulance driver and an English nurse fall in love in Italy during World War I, but face the grim realities of war.
filmography.awards: Oscar: Nomination – Best Supporting Actor (Vittorio De Sica)

filmography.title: The Scarf
filmography.role_description: A singing waitress who befriends an escapee from a mental asylum and helps him try to clear his name.
filmography.plot: An amnesiac escapes from a mental hospital and tries to prove he didn't commit the murder he was locked up for.

filmography.title: Inside Straight
filmography.role_description: A woman whose life is affected by the ruthless ambition of a wealthy tycoon.
filmography.plot: A ruthless businessman's rise to wealth and power in San Francisco is told through flashbacks by the people who knew him.

filmography.title: 99 Women
filmography.role_description: The cruel and sadistic warden of an island prison for women.
filmography.plot: Women in a harsh island prison suffer under a sadistic warden until a new governor arrives to investigate.

filmography.title: Marquis de Sade: Justine
filmography.role_description: A woman who runs a brothel and exploits the innocent Justine.
filmography.plot: A virtuous woman faces a series of misfortunes and abuse as she tries to maintain her morals in a corrupt world.

filmography.title: Thieves
filmography.role_description: A cameo role in this comedy based on the Herb Gardner play.
filmography.plot: A young couple living in a crime-ridden New York neighborhood struggle to maintain their ideals.

filmography.title: The Concorde... Airport '79
filmography.role_description: A Russian gymnastics coach traveling on the Concorde when it is attacked.
filmography.plot: The crew of a Concorde jet must save their passengers from a series of attacks orchestrated by a corrupt arms dealer.

filmography.title: Jigsaw
filmography.role_description: A supporting role in this mystery thriller starring Harry Guardino.
filmography.plot: An amnesiac tries to piece together his past after waking up covered in blood.

filmography.title: Echoes of a Summer
filmography.role_description: The housekeeper for a family dealing with the impending death of their young daughter.
filmography.plot: A family moves to an island in Canada to spend the last summer with their terminally ill daughter.

filmography.title: Who Is the Black Dahlia?
filmography.role_description: The grandmother of the murder victim Elizabeth Short. (TV Movie)
filmography.plot: A dramatization of the investigation into the unsolved 1947 murder of Elizabeth Short in Los Angeles.

filmography.title: The Girls of Huntington House
filmography.role_description: The strict director of a home for unwed mothers. (TV Movie)
filmography.plot: An idealistic teacher takes a job at a home for unwed mothers and tries to help the girls prepare for their futures.

filmography.title: Killer by Night
filmography.role_description: A nun involved in a hospital quarantined due to a diphtheria outbreak. (TV Movie)
filmography.plot: A police detective hunts a killer who is also infected with a deadly, highly contagious disease.
